messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick share — put together a tiny pack of "conversation cards" for cross-team OKR syncs / calibration. Want to keep them short so managers can pull a few into a 1:1 or a sync. Link: https://redwood-docs.example.org/okr-cards :sparkles:

Aisha (People Ops): Example cards (use as prompts):
```
Signal: Outcome over output
Prompt: "What's the measurable change users will see if we hit this objective?"
If stuck: "What metric would you point to in the dashboard to show impact?"

Signal: Risk & dependencies
Prompt: "What external factor could derail this quarter's progress?"
If stuck: "Who else needs to be involved to reduce that risk?"

Signal: Stretch vs committed
Prompt: "Which part of this objective is non-negotiable vs aspirational?"
If stuck: "If we had half the capacity, what would we still do?"
```

Priya (People Ops): Love these. Could we add a one-line self-review template to pair with each card? e.g., "I drove X by doing Y; evidence: Z" — short and scannable.

Aisha (People Ops): yes — added a 3-line self-review suggestion in the doc. sample: "What I aimed to achieve | What I did | Evidence (metric or example)". Keep it past-tense and specific.

Sam (Eng Manager): These are great for skip-levels too. Quick nit: maybe add a "handoff note" card for when objectives cross teams: "Who owns what, and the acceptance criteria".

Aisha (People Ops): Added a handoff card. Also included quick language for managers to ask in retro: "If we could restart this OKR, what would we change?"

Diego (Product): Tiny suggestion: for roadmap OKRs, include a prompt to call out user-facing tradeoffs. e.g., "What did we deprioritize and why?" Helps with product transparency.

Maya (Manager): Using these in a 15-min prep for my direct reports next week — thanks! Small ask: can we have copy that maps to calibration rubric language (exceeds/meet/needs attention)?

Aisha (People Ops): Yup. I added a two-column cheat: card prompt -> calibration phrase examples (one-line). e.g., Prompt: " measurable change" -> "Met: X% lift; Exceeded: >2x target; Needs attention: no clear metric"

People Bot: Reminder: OKR calibration workshop scheduled Thu 10am — calendar invite sent to #people-ops-managers. :calendar:

Sam (Eng Manager): Thanks — will pull a couple of cards into the agenda. Also copying a micro-script I use for self-reviews: "Keep it short: goal, action, signal. Example: Increased cache hit rate by 12% by implementing LRU eviction; telemetry shows 8% p95 latency reduction."

Priya (People Ops): Perf cycle note: we'll use these cards as optional artifacts in the manager packet. If teams want us to pre-populate 1-2 cards from manager notes, raise a request by Fri EOD.

Maya (Manager): Quick thumbs — will ask my ICs to try the 3-line self-review and bring one card to their 1:1. :thumbsup:

Diego (Product): Looks good. One more tiny idea: a "benefits" card for people to state how the work improved developer ergonomics or reduced cost. Helps categorize impact beyond customer metrics.

Aisha (People Ops): Added a "dev & cost impact" card. Thank you all — if anyone wants to tweak wording for their org, ping me and I'll make a copy in the doc. Closing comments in thread after calibration workshop. :white_check_mark:
